title: Planning for 2027 entry in the UK
summary: UCAS lists 15 October 2026 at 18:00 UK time for Oxford, Cambridge and most medicine, dentistry and veterinary courses. Most other undergraduate courses have a 13 January 2027, 18:00 UK time equal-consideration deadline. Check the deadline on your specific course.

title: Chevening’s 2027–28 application timetable
summary: The published scholarship application deadline is 6 October 2026 at 11:00 UTC. Successful applicants must submit at least one unconditional UK university offer by 8 July 2027 at 17:00 BST. Check country eligibility and eligible courses before applying; this is not a scholarship offer from every UK university.

title: Find funding for study and research in Germany
summary: DAAD funding primarily supports graduates, doctoral candidates and postdoctoral researchers. Eligibility, benefits and deadlines vary by call. Use the official scholarship database to match your country, subject and qualification.

title: MIT: required tests and language guidance
summary: MIT requires SAT or ACT results for first-year and transfer applicants. Its English-language guidance lists IELTS 7 as a minimum and 7.5 as recommended. Review the full policy for who should submit language results and which test dates apply.

title: MIT’s application checklist
summary: The first-year application includes academic history, essays, activities, recommendations and test scores. Financial aid has a separate application process. Use the official checklist for your application round.

title: TUM: choose a degree and check entry requirements
summary: TUM’s official degree finder lists programs and links to the course-specific qualification, language, application and admissions information. Requirements differ between degrees.

title: Oxford: undergraduate courses and requirements
summary: Explore Oxford’s undergraduate course list, then open your chosen course for entry requirements, admissions tests and course structure.
